build_casino_dataset: build the CaSiNo dataset by downloading train, valid, and test splits into the ParlAI datapath directory
build_casino_version_check: build the CaSiNo dataset only if the current version string does not match the already built version
download_casino_train: download the CaSiNo training data JSON file from the kushalchawla GitHub repository into the data directory
download_casino_valid: download the CaSiNo validation data JSON file from the kushalchawla GitHub repository into the data directory
download_casino_test: download the CaSiNo test data JSON file from the kushalchawla GitHub repository into the data directory
